meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后，它会系统地把项目里每一个源码文件从头到尾读完，大文件用分块翻页的方式读，以此建立对代码库的理解。
howto.when: 当你开始接触新项目或不熟悉的项目，或说出 “learn the codebase”“prime”“get up to speed” 等说法时触发。

say.text: 读完这个项目的所有源码，帮我建立整体理解
say.note: 它会逐个完整读取每个源文件

say.text: 我刚开始接手这个项目，先通读整个代码库
say.note: 大文件会按 offset/limit 分块翻页

say.text: get up to speed on 这个仓库再动手
say.note: 属于会消耗较多 token 的操作

howto.what_en: It reads every source file in the project in full, paging through large files with the Read tool's offset and limit parameters, so you build a deep understanding of the codebase.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you start work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when you ask to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

say_en.text: Read every source file in this project in full and prime me on it.
say_en.note: It reads each source file completely.

say_en.text: I'm new to this project, read the whole codebase first.
say_en.note: Large files are paged in chunks.

say_en.text: get up to speed on this repo before we start.
